sources.label: Bridge reserve management: Treasury reserves redeemable within one business day; reviewed 2026-10-03

reserveReview.rationale: Bridge's USDsui transparency response at 2026-10-27T16:10:42Z reports total reserves and total on-chain amount of $77,230,964.78, comprising cash $7,723,096.48 and Treasury $69,507,868.30, with collateralization ratio 1.0. The disclosed amounts sum exactly to the denominator. Exact decimal division gives 10.0000% cash and 90.0000% Treasury. The prior 2026-10-01 capture was 10.2927% cash and 89.7073% Treasury on $76,870,543.20. Only the percentage and date are refreshed: the existing risk tiers and asset classes are not upgraded or newly validated, and aggregate Treasury remains insufficient to settle the separate instrument-classification proposal.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Bridge public USDsui transparency API capture normalized by disclosed reserve category
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The public USDsui transparency API discloses the complete USDsui composition as cash and Treasury; provider-level custody and instrument details are not part of this composition capture.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Bridge identifies Lead Bank for liquid reserves, BlackRock and Fidelity as custody partners, and segregated bankruptcy-remote accounts, but does not publish USDsui-specific provider allocations or rehypothecation terms.
